notes.title: Update on our progress (03/17/2020)
notes.content:
Hi there!

We haven't been able to continue working for a few weeks, but in a few days we will be able to work at full capacity again. There are some problems with animations, the characters and the user interface, but the basic principle is already recreated and even better than before. Many bugs have also been found and successfully fixed. There is still a lot of work to be done to provide the best experiences for you. The single player mode will be developed after the multiplayer mode. A lot of changes will be made there to add more features and to achieve a better and more exciting gaming adventure. Stay excited!

notes.title: Important information!
notes.content:
Hi! Important information in advance.

Due to an error, many files of the game are corrupted. We will not be able to repair them. Therefore we ask you to be patient for the next update, as we have to develop the game from scratch.

However, we have gained a lot of experience in the last months, so we will be able to make many improvements.

We ask for your understanding and your patience. It will go on and do it better and bigger than ever!

Your tylobix team

notes.title: Kill or Die - Reboot
notes.content:
The multiplayer game mode "Kill or Die" is currently undergoing a complete makeover.

There are a lot of changes. We have gathered a lot of experience with you over the last months and have listened to many criticisms and ideas from you. Now we have deleted all old files of the game mode since this week and started from scratch.

Surprisingly, we worked very fast and without any problems. For this reason you will be able to play the mode for the moment. But that's not it yet. 

We've planned a lot of new elements and some are already implemented. Be very excited, it could already be in December!

notes.title: Halloween Sale
notes.content:
This game is part of the Steam Halloweensale. Pay only 10% of the normal price and enter the early access phase of the game!


Dive into the world of "The Creature" now and survive in a world with friends or alone.

Once there was a civilization on this island. After 40 years the first radio messages reached the mainland. You are on your way there with your team. But something happens that no one could have foreseen. Now you are on your own. But you learned in the academy how to survive in the wilderness and now you act accordingly. But you're not all alone on the island, because there's a monster, a creature that kills everything that comes near it. And there are other survivors as well. Whether they are hostile...?

Build your base in single player mode, fight your enemies and above all: survive!

In multiplayer mode, you can play with up to five other players, as there are four teenagers entering forbidden land, an island long abandoned and forgotten. Exactly then, a creature falls on this island. Their intention: to open a portal and get more of their species to wipe out all life and occupy Planet Earth.

notes.title: Singleplayer is available now!
notes.content:
We have been working on the singleplayer mode "Hunt" for some time now. Now, this mode is publicly available. Now we want to develop this mode together with you. If you have any ideas, please send us an e-mail to tylobix@gmail.com!

You are on your way with an exploration team. Suddenly you smell smoke. A loud bang! The engine, it's down! You crash...

After some time you wake up. Everyone is dead. You are the only survivor... You get up and... What was that?! A loud roar...

notes.title: Important Singleplayer Announcement!
notes.content:
We are working for a singleplayer mode since the last update. That's the reason why we didn't changed anything in the Multiplayer. The upcoming gamemode is going to be gigantic! We already posted some showcases on Twitter, YouTube and Instagram (@tylobix).

Stay tuned and share this game to all friends!

After the Singleplayer Mode we'll make it multiplayer compatible!
